# surge for mac external 代理转发



都说 surge for mac 具有 external 外部代理转发功能，但是具体来说对于现在的新协议比如，vless-vison-reality quantum encryption 等如何写这个

```
[Proxy]
external = external, exec = "/usr/bin/ssh", args = "11.22.33.44", args = "-D", args = "127.0.0.1:1080", local-port = 1080, addresses = 11.22.33.44
```

比如这样

```
[Proxy]
RFC香港-h9gft58y=external,exec="/usr/local/bin/mihomo",local-port=65535,args="-config",args="",addresses=23.249.19.12
```
